goal: Add independent private notes using acknowledged R07 save and route saved chat/Tarot back to the matching existing source without new AI calls or unrelated Tarot fallback.
successCriteria: Create a manual note with title, text and mood without an AI reading; retain draft on local failure and prevent duplicate submit.
Manual notes appear in Notes, survive reload, and share R07 storage/sync states.
Saved Tarot opens its stable saved reading; Persona and Oracle reopen only if matching source history remains; other sources show an explicit unavailable status without starting a new reading.
untouchedSurfaces: R07 server contract/schema and provider prompts are unchanged.
No cloud mutation deployment, DB migration, account deletion, subscriptions or copyrighted source changes.
Astrology structured saved-chart restoration remains a separate R18/device gate; saved summary stays readable.

impact.entryPoint: Journal list/empty state create note; note composer and saved insight source action.
impact.dataWrite: Existing JournalEntry sourceType manual with title/summary/mood through R07 repository; no new store.
impact.backendContract: Existing authenticated Journal upsert already accepts manual. No new endpoint or privileged action.
impact.adminVisibility: No notes or raw snapshots in Admin; existing sourceType-only event.
impact.privacySafety: Private account scope; no AI transmission from writing/reopen; draft retained on failure; missing source never triggers another reading.
impact.observability: Local acknowledged save and pending/synced states from R07; no raw draft logging.
impact.rollback: Scoped component/route rollback preserves manual entries in R07 envelope and uses existing sourceType/schema.

canonicalContracts: PRD 6.7 manual note and source revisit; JournalEntry schema and R07 envelope remain canonical.
Only existing matched source IDs/session history determine route; no invented new provider output.

skillReview.evidence: Fresh impact map, one App integration owner, preserved owner dirty edits and separate local/native/live acceptance.

skillReview.name: nilaza-brand-experience
skillReview.evidence: Layout uses current typography, bilingual access/action text, original Tarot assets on Tarot surfaces and explicit browser/native status.

dependencyReview.evidence: No new libraries/APIs. Existing React Native TextInput and acknowledged repository behavior retained.

securityReview.authzRls: Existing account-scoped R07 store and authenticated upsert; no new grants or privilege.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Notes private; no provider/admin/log transmission. UI source routing only uses current account history.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No credentials/env reads or raw notes in events.
securityReview.externalInput: Bound title 160 and body 10000; disable empty submit and serialize submission. Only current valid persona/message is reopened.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No DB schema/migration, deployment or publication; environment identity investigation blocks live actions.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop on unsupported snapshot restore, missing source, database change or live publishing; show unavailable rather than route to unrelated screen.

workingTreeReview.note: One root App owner; all existing changes preserved; exact R08 files only.

validationCommands: Browser create fictional note, reload/reopen, filter Notes; unit fail/duplicate-submit; no irreversible browser deletion.
managerTestPath: Journal -> Write note -> title/body/mood -> save -> Notes -> reload -> open/edit; reopen saved Tarot and a matching current chat, unavailable source must not create new reading.
residualRisk: Native, cross-device cloud and chart restoration acceptance remain separate. Live DB identity issue under read-only investigation.
